result.summary: No clear layout-breaking defects are visible. The page structure, cards, carousel clipping, and fixed bottom navigation appear intentional. One content label looks potentially incorrect.

issues.description: The promotion badge on the partially visible pizza card reads “−100%,” which is confusing and visually resembles an invalid negative discount.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearer offer label such as “100% off” or “Free,” and ensure the promotion value is formatted consistently with the rest of the page.
